style: English, indie folk pop, warm clear lead vocal, acoustic guitar, bass, gentle drums, 100 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
The morning train rolls past the hill
The river shines, the town is still
I take the road that leads to you
The sky unfolds in gold and blue

[Chorus]
Carry me home through the light
We keep a song through the night
One little spark, one open door
We find the world we're looking for
